correctness.rationale: Set S=z₁²+z₂², r=|z₃|. In the closed ball, |S^m+εz₃²|≤(1-r²)^m+εr²≤1-(1-ε)r²; strictness for r>0 or interior r=0 forces all boundary zeros to z₃=0, S^m=1 and triangle equality. Those equalities yield precisely disjoint phase-rotated real unit circles indexed j modulo m. The irreducible prime 1-S=1-(z₁+iz₂)(z₁-iz₂) appears to exponent one in constant term 1-S^m, with quotient value m modulo that prime; leading z₃² coefficient -ε is a unit. Eisenstein in C[z₁,z₂][z₃] proves irreducible for all m. Nonzero (z₁,z₂) gives nonzero complex gradient at each circle. The parametrized tangents satisfy Σ conj(z_j) dz_j/dt=0, and the real planes e^{πij/m}R² are invariant under the common orthogonal complex structure J'(z₁,z₂)=(-z₂,z₁); hence they are distinct Hopf fibers and all pairwise linking magnitudes in the equatorial S³ equal one. Independently checked prime multiplicity symbolically for m=1..6; infinite m proof is Eisenstein, not finite testing.
residual_risks: Legendrian is asserted only in the 3-sphere, not as a 1-dimensional Legendrian of contact S⁵; linking is in that S³.
The polynomials have increasing degree; no optimal degree/component bound or other link types are claimed.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The one-variable lift of 1-S^m has m circles but decomposes as ∏(1-ζS); Knese et al. explicitly state this reducibility. The -εz₃² term vanishes on the boundary circles but is not a factor-preserving change: Eisenstein proves irreducible. This prevents the older reducible theorem from implying the conjunction of irreducibility, exact m components, and Hopf linking.

value.rationale: The distinction between reducible liftings and irreducible ball-stable polynomials with arbitrarily many disjoint, pairwise-linked smooth boundary components is a substantive geometric boundary phenomenon, not just a renamed degree parameter. It supplies a uniform constructive counterexample to any irreducible fixed-dimension component bound and an exactly controlled link type.
residual_risks: The family does not realize arbitrary links or establish minimal degree; m=1 is the familiar quadratic case.

final_claim: For all m≥1 and 0<ε<1, 1-(z₁²+z₂²)^m-εz₃² is irreducible and zero-free in the open complex unit 3-ball; its boundary zero set consists of exactly m smooth Hopf-linked great circles, Legendrian in the equatorial S³.
limitations: The linking and Legendrian terminology refer specifically to the equatorial S³; in S⁵ the curves are complex-tangential only.
Global m-family and irreducibility are proved; no bound on optimal degree, arbitrary link realization or higher-dimensional classification.
